edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument into _transfer.
Sender reflection balance _rOwned[from] is debited in _transferStandard.
Recipient reflection balance _rOwned[to] is credited in _transferStandard.
Transfer amount flows into _transferStandard for value computation.
block.timestamp is stored into the cooldown mapping for the buyer.
cooldown[to] timestamp is read to gate transfers in _transfer.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
manualswap authorizes on msg.sender == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes on msg.sender == _feeAddrWallet1.
_msgSender is compared against _owner by the onlyOwner modifier.
Contract token balance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth.
Contract ETH balance is passed as the amount to sendETHToFee.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping.
delBot writes false into the bots mapping.
_transferStandard adjusts both sender and recipient entries of _rOwned.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned of the contract address with the team reflections.
_reflectFee performs _rTotal.sub(rFee) arithmetic on the reflection supply.
_reflectFee performs _tFeeTotal.add(tFee) arithmetic on accumulated fees.
_getTValues reads the _feeAddr1 percentage for fee computation.
_getTValues reads the _feeAddr2 percentage for team fee computation.
_getRate divides the reflection supply _rTotal by the token supply.
_getCurrentSupply compares and divides _rTotal by _tTotal.
tokenFromReflection derives balances from the _rOwned mapping.
_approve writes the amount into the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
balanceOf reads _rOwned[account] before rate conversion.
Constructor assigns the deployer to _owner via _msgSender.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0) under onlyOwner.
transfer forwards execution into _transfer.
transferFrom forwards execution into _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to refresh the remaining allowance.
approve calls the internal _approve writer.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth when swap conditions hold.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee when the contract holds ETH.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team amount.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with fee amounts.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-side values.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-side values.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for the supply pair.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert team tokens to reflections.
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection for the conversion.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
openTrading stores the router instance into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading flips tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to the 50B token cap.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag under onlyOwner.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the whole contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transfer performs the external router swap before state is fully settled.
_transfer forwards ETH to external fee wallets during execution.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor reads msg.sender through _msgSender to mint the supply.
External swap target could re-enter token logic that mutates _rOwned before completion.
ETH .transfer to fee wallet is an external call reachable during transfer processing.
addLiquidityETH calls the pair/router externally while trading state is being set.
